ONE SHEET with a walnut top: exact at the playing
1. What changes from ONE SHEET, and what
heights, every control, the main board, the I/O board
on the printed rear wall with the jack barrels flush in
its holes, the speaker, the battery, the back panel,
2. The rear band becomes a walnut top, laid on the
shell like a tabletop on its apron.
3. Two bookmatched leaves joined on the axis by one
4. A French-cleat slot in the back panel, to hang.
3. Construction: the top and the apron
Drilling the jacks through the wood fails: the rail is 15
mm deep at its thinnest. What works, and it's honest
furniture: a tabletop over an apron. The printed shell
keeps its rear wall with the I/O board and the flush
French-cleat slot routed at 45° along the back panel's
rear zone, y ≈ 150–170, x ≈ 40–200. It clears the
speaker. Hung, the tree side is up, the knobs face the
